nights.subtitle: Three services, same experience
nights.streamNote: All three also streaming live online

eyebrow: Christmas Eve services in Omaha, NE
heading: Two nights. Four services. *One story.*
lede: Every service is the same one-hour Christmas experience. Pick the time that works for your crew. All times are CST.
whereNote: An easy drive from anywhere in the Omaha metro.
doorsText: Worship Center doors open thirty minutes before each service. Seats are first come, first served, and there’s plenty of room.
accessText: Wednesday’s 6:00 PM service is ASL-interpreted and live-captioned in the Worship Center.
planText: Let us know which service you’re planning on, and we’ll be ready for you.
